messages:
Maya: Kicking off capacity handoff for KiteLabs — they expect ~800 qps steady with 1.2k short peaks. Need quota signoff + autoscale policy finalized. @Ethan can you confirm reserved pool size and warmup window? Planning a full load bakeoff Friday 09:00 PT. @Priya can you run enablement right before the test?

Ethan: Confirming current reservation = 6 x p4d (estimated 900 qps aggregated w/ current batching). Proposed autoscale policy: min=4, max=10, scale_step=1, cooldown=120s. Short warmup (15m) to prime KV cache suggested. Also need to validate prefix cache hit rate for KiteLabs convo patterns.

Priya: Got it — I'll do enablement Thursday 16:00 PT (walk through runbook + test harness). Please share the exact test command and target endpoint so we can mirror it. I'll also prepare a one-page checklist for their SRE.

Maya: Sending the test snippet below — prefer running against staging first, then prod-dryrun. Note: customer mentioned renewal conversation will hinge on stable p95 token latency and predictable cost. Capture any quality regressions during bakeoff.

perf-bot: Load test script sample:
```
# targets.txt
POST https://staging-infer.redwood.dev/v1/generate
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "model": "rwkv-large-v2",
  "input": "<standardized_prompt_set>",
  "max_tokens": 256,
  "temperature": 0.2
}

# run (example using vegeta)
vegeta attack -targets=targets.txt -rate=800 -duration=10m | vegeta report -type='hist,percentiles'
```

Liam: We can provision Friday 09:00 PT. Quick ask: can you do a precheck for quota/permissions today so we don't hit IAM hiccups on Friday?

Ethan: On it. Running quota & IAM precheck now. Also kicking a quick smoke to prime model KV caches (script below). Will post smoke numbers in ~20m.

perf-bot: Smoke run results (staging):
- baseline (no prime): steady ~770 qps, p95 token latency 86ms
- after prime (10m conversation priming): steady ~820 qps, p95 token latency 52ms
Notes: batching window 64 tokens, no token loss observed. Full 10m bakeoff still recommended to validate autoscale transitions.

Maya: Nice. @Priya please capture enablement feedback and any UI/credential friction. If p95 stays >100ms post-bakeoff we flag a renewal risk for CS/AM to escalate. Also plan fallback policy to a slightly faster quantized model (rwkv-large-q4) if cost/perf tradeoffs require it.

Priya: Will do. I'll use the "enablement -> bakeoff notes" template and post the summary to the customer thread + shared handoff doc. I'll also request their preferred success criteria (p95, cost per 1k tokens).

Ethan: FYI I'm adding an autoscale monitor to alert@pager on >2 scale events in 1h during the bakeoff so we can react fast.

Maya: Perfect — thanks team. Friday plan stands: Thu 16:00 PT enablement, Fri 09:00 PT bakeoff. :thumbsup:
